title_en: Heyuan City Labor Service Construction Engineering Company v. Longchuan County People's Government — dispute over a construction project contract
ruling_gist_en: After the plaintiff has filed a claim and obtained a final judgment from the people's court, if the plaintiff subsequently files another lawsuit based on the difference between the actual amount in dispute and the original claim, this constitutes a second lawsuit on the same factual dispute and violates the civil litigation principle of non bis in idem (res judicata). The people's court shall not uphold such a claim.

full_text_en:
Heyuan City Labor Service Construction Engineering Company v. Longchuan County People's Government — dispute over construction project contract

【Ruling Summary】

Where a plaintiff files a claim and the people's court renders a final judgment, and the plaintiff thereafter files a separate lawsuit for the amount exceeding the original claim on the ground that the actual subject matter of the dispute exceeds the original claim, such action constitutes a new lawsuit on the same disputed facts, violating the civil litigation principle of res judicata. The people's court shall not support such action.

Supreme People's Court
Civil Ruling

(2011) Min Zai Shen Zi No. 68

Applicant for Retrial (Plaintiff at First Instance, Appellee at Second Instance, Original Respondent): Heyuan City Labor Service Construction Engineering Company. Domicile: No. 163 Hongxing Road, Xinshi, Heyuan City, Guangdong Province.

Legal Representative: Chen Pengguang, Manager of the Company.

Agent ad litem: Li Xiuyun, Lawyer at Beijing Rongshang Law Firm.

Respondent (Defendant at First Instance, Appellant at Second Instance, Original Applicant for Retrial): Longchuan County People's Government. Domicile: County Government Compound, No. 20 Zhongshan East Road, Laolong Town, Longchuan County, Heyuan City, Guangdong Province.

Legal Representative: Wei Qinqiang, Acting County Magistrate.

Agent ad litem: Jiang Tongguang, Lawyer at Guangdong Zhong'an Law Firm.

Agent ad litem: Cong Songping, Lawyer at Guangdong Zhong'an Law Firm.

The applicant for retrial, Heyuan City Labor Service Construction Engineering Company (hereinafter referred to as Laofu Company), in respect of the dispute over a construction project contract with the respondent, Longchuan County People's Government (hereinafter referred to as Longchuan County Government), dissatisfied with the civil ruling (2010) Yue Gao Fa Shen Jian Min Zai Zi No. 11 (hereinafter referred to as the Retrial Ruling) rendered by the Guangdong High People's Court (hereinafter referred to as Guangdong High Court), applied to this Court for retrial. This Court formed a collegial panel in accordance with the law to examine this case, and the examination has now been concluded.

Laofu Company applied for retrial on the following grounds: (1) There is new evidence sufficient to overturn the Retrial Ruling. The project payment settlement statement dated December 15, 2005, submitted by Laofu Company constitutes new evidence, proving that both parties confirmed that the project payment of RMB 4,506,688 owed by Longchuan County Government and the interest were under litigation and were not within the scope of the settlement. (2) The basic facts found by the Retrial Ruling lack evidentiary support. The civil judgment (2004) Yue Gao Fa Min Yi Zhong Zi No. 402 (hereinafter referred to as Judgment No. 402) rendered by the Guangdong High Court did not adjudicate on the project payment of RMB 4,506,688. The separate lawsuit filed by Laofu Company for this part of the project payment does not violate the principle of res judicata. The Retrial Ruling's determination that Laofu Company's new lawsuit on the cost of the project involved violated the principle of res judicata lacks evidentiary support. (3) The application of law in the Retrial Ruling is indeed erroneous. The "Audit Report" (Shen He Bao Gao) issued by the Design Office of Heyuan Highway Bureau and the "Opinion on Review of the Adjusted Investment Scale for the Reconstruction Project of Provincial Highway 227 (formerly 1920) Section from Laolong, Longchuan to Jiangguangting" (Jian Yi) issued by the Guangdong Provincial Highway Engineering Cost Management Station (Guangdong Jiao Zao Jia [2003] No. 091) (hereinafter referred to as the "Review Opinion"), relied upon by the Retrial Ruling, were not issued by entities with qualifications for construction cost consulting enterprises, and thus the application of law is erroneous. (4) The Retrial Ruling omitted the claim for relief. The Retrial Ruling omitted the fact that both parties signed to acknowledge that Judgment No. 402 did not adjudicate on the project payment of RMB 4,506,688. Laofu Company applied for retrial pursuant to subparagraphs (1), (2), (6), and (12) of the first paragraph of Article 179 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China.

Longchuan County Government submitted its opinion, contending that Laofu Company's application for retrial lacks factual and legal basis and requesting its dismissal.

This Court holds as follows: 1. Regarding whether the project payment settlement statement dated December 15, 2005, submitted by Laofu Company constitutes new evidence. The project payment settlement statement submitted by Laofu Company existed during the second instance of this case, but Laofu Company failed to submit it without justifiable reasons. This evidence does not conform to the provisions on "new evidence" set forth in Article 10 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of the Trial Supervision Procedure of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and therefore does not constitute new evidence. 2. Regarding whether the Retrial Ruling's finding that Laofu Company's lawsuit violated the principle of res judicata lacks evidentiary support. On February 18, 2004, Laofu Company filed a lawsuit with the Heyuan Intermediate People's Court of Guangdong Province (hereinafter referred to as Heyuan Intermediate Court) based on the "Audit Report", requesting Longchuan County Government and the Longchuan County Transportation and Highway Construction Headquarters to pay project payments of RMB 15,061,995.39. During the litigation, Laofu Company, based on the "Third Phase Project Cost Appraisal Report" (hereinafter referred to as the "Appraisal Report") issued by Heyuan Zhenfeng Construction Cost Consulting Co., Ltd., added a claim for the principal amount of project payment of RMB 4,506,688 and interest, but later withdrew the added claim on the ground that it could not pay the litigation fees. The Heyuan Intermediate Court, in its first instance judgment based on the "Audit Report", ordered Longchuan County Government to pay Laofu Company project payments of RMB 15,061,995.39 and interest thereon. After the first instance judgment was rendered, Longchuan County Government filed an appeal. In Judgment No. 402, the Guangdong High Court, on the basis of the first instance judgment, deducted the project payments already paid as reconfirmed by both parties during the second instance, and ordered Longchuan County Government to pay Laofu Company project payments of RMB 14,792,283.71 and interest. This judgment has taken legal effect. In the first lawsuit, Laofu Company based its claim on the "Audit Report" and made corresponding claims. It was only because the project cost confirmed by the "Appraisal Report" during the litigation was higher than that confirmed by the "Audit Report" that Laofu Company added the claim, which it later withdrew on the ground of inability to pay litigation fees. Laofu Company also did not appeal the first instance judgment of Heyuan Intermediate Court. Judgment No. 402 of the Guangdong High Court is the final judgment on the entire project payment involved in the case. After this judgment was rendered, Laofu Company filed a separate lawsuit on the project payment again, which constitutes a new lawsuit on the same disputed facts and violates the principle of res judicata. Therefore, the Retrial Ruling dismissing Laofu Company's lawsuit is well-founded in fact. 3. Regarding whether the application of law in the Retrial Ruling is indeed erroneous. The Retrial Ruling only examined whether Laofu Company's new lawsuit violated the principle of res judicata, and did not make any determination on the amount of the project payment, nor did it rely on the "Audit Report" or the "Review Opinion" as the basis for finding facts. Therefore, Laofu Company's ground for retrial that the application of law in the Retrial Ruling is erroneous cannot be sustained. 4. Regarding whether the Retrial Ruling omitted the claim for relief. The fact that both parties signed to acknowledge that Judgment No. 402 did not adjudicate the project payment of RMB 4,506,688 is a matter of fact, not a claim for relief. Moreover, the Retrial Ruling dismissed Laofu Company's lawsuit and did not involve a determination of the project payment. Therefore, there is no issue of omission of a claim for relief in this case.

In summary, Laofu Company's application for retrial does not meet the circumstances set forth in subparagraphs (1), (2), (6), and (12) of the first paragraph of Article 179 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China. Pursuant to the first paragraph of Article 181 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the ruling is as follows:

The application for retrial of Heyuan City Labor Service Construction Engineering Company is dismissed.

Presiding Judge: Zhang Guorong

Judge: Xiao Baoying
